name: analenzor-user-behaviour-analytics
author: analenzor

sections.description:
Analenzor is a user behaviour tracking plugin with full session replay capabilities.
It allows you to monitor visitor actions, clicks, scrolls, and even full user sessions for behaviour analysis.

External Services

This plugin connects to the “Analenzor Dashboard” API to provide user behavior analytics, session replay and SEO checks.

  • The script is loaded from: https://dashboard.analenzor.com/api/script
  • The tracking script sends anonymized user behavior data (clicks, scrolls, session duration, etc.) to Analenzor servers for analytics purposes.
  • Data is collected only after the site owner configures and activates the plugin.
  • This service is provided by Analenzor:
    • Terms of Service: https://dashboard.analenzor.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://dashboard.analenzor.com/privacy

Features

  • Session Replay (record and replay user activity)
  • User Interaction Tracking (clicks, scrolls, mouse movements)
  • Lightweight and fast
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/analenzor-user-behaviour-analytics directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the ‘Analenzor’ settings page to configure the plugin.
